Provide project context and coding guidelines that AI should follow when generating code, answering questions, or reviewing changes.
# CAT Mod Demo Workflow Instructions
dont conclude test success unless 100% tests pass and all issues are resolved.
dont force a test to pass if it is legitimately failing.
always map out the entire code base (if required even programatically) to understand how new code will fit in.
Architecture, end functionality, and rigorous testing and their outcomes should always align with business goals and user needs are more important than speed of delivery.
when you create new assets, components, modules, or services, ensure they follow existing naming conventions and project structure.
document all changes, new features, and bug fixes thoroughly in markdown files within the documentation/ directory
